visa_types.name: Tourist Purpose
visa_types.documents_required:
- A national passport
, valid for at least three months after the expiration date of the requested visa and having at least 2 blank visa designated pages, not to be
                                                                            issued more than 10 years ago. Copies of travel documents (PASSPORT) are not accepted;
- Application form
(application form have to be filled on-line (
please apply online at http://visa.mfa.gov.ua (http://visa.mfa.gov.ua/) 
).
                                                                            After completing forms prompted to save the file in .pdf format. This file have to be printed and signed);
- 1 photo
- recent, passport-sized, resembling applicant's travel document photo;
- Payment of consular fee
. Money transfer receipt for visa fee and a copy of it (payment reference is applicants surname, separate payment should be done for each visa
                                                                            application);
- Valid international travel or medical (health) insurance. Valid health insurance with coverage of at least 30,000 EUR or equivalent in other currency, unless otherwise stipulated
                                                                                by legislation or international treaties of Ukraine. When multi-entry visa is requested, availability of health insurance valid for the first intended visit to Ukraine shall
                                                                                be considered. Holders of diplomatic or service passport shall be exempt from this requirement;
                                                                            
- 
The insurance policy covering treatment of COVID-19 should be purchased from the Ukrainian insurance company. Further information can be found on this link - https://clicktime.symantec.com/3G7GT1U5i1r5AKL6sCDusM17Vc?u=https%3A%2F%2Fvisitukraine.today%2F (https://clicktime.symantec.com/3G7GT1U5i1r5AKL6sCDusM17Vc?u=https%3A%2F%2Fvisitukraine.today%2F)
- Proof of the applicant’s financial  sufficiency
for the intended period of stay and return to the country of origin, or transit to a third country, or the possibility
                                                                            to legally obtain sufficient financial means on the territory of Ukraine, as required by the Rules for proving financial sufficiency of foreigners and stateless persons for entry
                                                                            to Ukraine, stay on the territory of Ukraine, transit through the territory of Ukraine and departure from Ukraine, and establishment of the amount of such sufficiency, approved
                                                                            by the Resolution of the Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine of 4 December 2013 no.884. When multi-entry visa is requested, financial sufficiency for the first planned visit to Ukraine
                                                                            shall be considered. Holders of diplomatic or service passport shall be exempt from this requirement;
- Together with all items listed above the  following documents, each hereinafter referred to as "the supporting  document", related to the purpose of entry, must be submitted for visas  (section “Visa types”).
- 
If you submit a child's  passport, it should be accompanied by a joint request of both  parents with signatures certified by JP, Police, Notary
                                                                                Public and copy  of the child’s certificate of birth.
- 
Please note: The Consular office has full authority to evaluate and request more documents than those submitted by the applicant. The latter is hereby informed
                                                                                that submitting the aforementioned documents does not guarantee automatic issuance of the visa.
Requirements specific to the purpose of the visit -
- Documents  confirming that the purpose of travel is tourism; (original touristic voucher  of relevant touristic agency/touristic agreement, booking or payment of hotel  services, booking of excursions, two-way tickets, etc);
visa_types.processing_time:
Usually decision on a visa application is made within a period of 10 working days, 14 calendar days when application received at the Ukrainian mission in Canberra, Australia. It is advised
                                                                        to submit visa application at least 30 calendar days before the intended visit. A visa application cannot be submitted earlier than three months before the intended date of travel.
In some cases, which are exclusively determined by the Embassy, processing time can be extended up to 30 working days.
Urgent processing of visa application for New Zealand citizens may take up to 5 working days (7 calendar days). The Consular section does not guarantee that the decision will be taken
                                                                        in the frame of terms, as occurrence of necessity of additional consultations is possible. Urgent procedure also implies that all the supporting documents are present and the application
                                                                        DOES NOT needs more information for decision taking.
visa_types.overview:
Overview
Tourist visa is granted for those applicants who intend to visit Ukraine for tourism and sightseeing without having an invitation from a Ukrainian referent.
visa_types.application_form:
Application form must be filled online and must be signed by the applicant himself/herself after printing the online filled form.
Portal access to complete the online application form (https://visa.mfa.gov.ua/).

visa_types.overview:
C type (short term) visas are issued in cases where a foreigner/stateless person intends to stay in Ukraine for up to 90 days (within every 180 days).
C type visas are issued as single / double / multiple entry visas valid for 6 months or another period depending on supporting documents but cannot be issued for more than a 5 year-term.
